record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: Let Ω be a bounded domain in ℝⁿ with n ≥ 4. For the clamped plate eigenvalue problem Δ²w = Γw in Ω with boundary conditions w = 0 and ∂w/∂n = 0 on ∂Ω, must the lowest eigenvalue Γ₁ satisfy the Faber-Krahn-type inequality |Ω|^{4/n} Γ₁ ≥ (|Ω|^{4/n} Γ₁)_{n-ball}?

evidence.quote: For Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ with n ≥ 4 prove that the lowest eigenvalue Γ₁ of (39)-(40) satisfies |Ω|^{4/n} Γ₁ ≥ (|Ω|^{4/n} Γ₁)|n-ball.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 4$ and let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain. Consider the clamped plate eigenvalue problem
$$\Delta^2 w = \Gamma\, w \quad \text{in } \Omega, \qquad w = 0,\ \ \frac{\partial w}{\partial \nu} = 0 \quad \text{on } \partial\Omega,$$
where $\Delta$ is the Laplacian on $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\Delta^2$ the biharmonic operator, and $\nu$ the outward unit normal on $\partial\Omega$. Let $\Gamma_1(\Omega)$ denote the lowest eigenvalue of this problem, and let $|\Omega|$ denote the $n$-dimensional Lebesgue measure of $\Omega$. Let $B \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a ball (of any radius). Prove or disprove the following Faber–Krahn-type inequality:
$$|\Omega|^{4/n}\, \Gamma_1(\Omega) \ \geq \ |B|^{4/n}\, \Gamma_1(B),$$
with equality if and only if $\Omega$ is a ball.
artifact.status_search_result: Lord Rayleigh's conjecture for the clamped plate was proved in dimension 2 by Nadirashvili (1995) and in dimension 3 by Ashbaugh–Benguria (1995). For dimensions n ≥ 4 the conjecture remains open; recent work (e.g., Stollenwerk and others, 2023–2024) gives only partial/conditional results.

status_evidence.title: Towards the optimality of the ball for the Rayleigh Conjecture concerning the clamped plate
status_evidence.snippet: The conjecture has been shown to hold in 1995 by Nadirashvili in dimension 2 and by Ashbaugh and Benguria in dimension 3. Since then, the conjecture remains open in dimension d≥4.
status_evidence.claim: The Rayleigh clamped-plate conjecture is open for n ≥ 4.

status_evidence.title: Sufficient conditions yielding the Rayleigh Conjecture for the clamped plate
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions yielding the Rayleigh Conjecture for the clamped plate.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides only conditional sufficient conditions in higher dimensions.
